title: Miami museums that are free

scenes.text: These Miami museums are free, and most people pay anyway.
scenes.caption: These Miami museums are free, and most people pay anyway.

scenes.text: This weekend, October third and fourth, Bank of America cardholders get in free at the Freedom Tower, PAMM, the Bass, and MOCA. Just bring your card and your ID.
scenes.caption: This weekend, Oct. 3 and 4, Bank of America cardholders get in free at the Freedom Tower, PAMM, the Bass, and MOCA. Just bring your card and your ID.
scenes.sub: Bank of America cardholders · Museums on Us

scenes.text: ICA Miami in the Design District is free every single day. Three floors of contemporary art, plus a sculpture garden.
scenes.caption: ICA Miami in the Design District is free every single day. Three floors of contemporary art, plus a sculpture garden.

scenes.text: On Miami Beach, the Wolfsonian is always free for Florida residents. Just show your ID.
scenes.caption: On Miami Beach, the Wolfsonian is always free for Florida residents. Just show your ID.

scenes.text: The Lowe Art Museum at the University of Miami has free general admission, all year.
scenes.caption: The Lowe Art Museum at the University of Miami has free general admission, all year.

scenes.text: And PAMM, right on the bay, is free for everyone on the second Saturday of every month. The next one is October tenth.
scenes.caption: And PAMM, right on the bay, is free for everyone on the second Saturday of every month. The next one is Oct. 10.

scenes.text: A museum is full of people looking at the same art as you that you'll never actually meet, and NEAR shows you who they were after you leave. Tag who you're taking.
